description: Search relay services tracked by OkkMax by station name, slug, domain, URL, or model ID. Returns matching relays in leaderboard order with their current metrics. Use get_station for a full report.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text (statement, reason, notes, suggestions) and of the OkkMax page links. Pass zh when the user writes Chinese, otherwise en. Field names and data values are the same either way.

query.description: Free text: a relay name, slug, domain or URL, or a model ID such as claude-opus. Omit to list the top of the leaderboard.

name: search_stations

dataAsOf.description: ISO 8601 time the underlying OkkMax data was last updated (not the time of this response). null when unavailable.

startingInputPricePer1M.description: Lowest input price across ALL models this relay lists. It is the relay's entry price, not the price of any specific model: use get_model_board or get_station with model for a model's price.

suggestions.description: Present when nothing matched: what to try next.

title: Search relay stations
